stage1.impression: A moody dusk table scene with a cylindrical lamp glowing red through stacked translucent bands under a frosted cap. The glow is one flat clipped red bar, the foot falls into pure black, the table shows no light pool, and the cropped books, the cropped plate and a sliver at the left edge pull the eye.

blocking_9: The lamp's light must visibly pool on the table: the table in front of the lamp [480,670,720,770] must be clearly brighter and redder/warmer than the table far right [850,650,1150,780]. Both now read lum_median 34.3.
The glowing core must hold its hue. The bar [565,300,635,520] is 76% clipped, with R at 254, so it reads as a flat sticker rather than lit acrylic.
The black foot must have a readable edge. [470,560,720,650] is 96% crushed (lum_median 1.0) and disappears into the table's shadow.
The strata must separate: the side bands [455,300,545,520] are one red at lum_median 11, with no visible sheen difference between buffed and bead-blasted discs.
No prop may be cut by the frame edge, and no unexplained object may sit at the edge: the books at x 0-290, the plate and pear at x 1040-1200, and the light sliver at x 0-15, y 600-800.

changes.problem: The room fill lights the table evenly, so the lamp's coloured light on the table (the point of the frame) does not register.

evidence.measured: In front of the lamp: lum_median 34.3 (R60 G28 B18). Far-right table [850,650,1150,780]: lum_median 34.3 (R48 G31 B23). Table x-profile 22, 25, 21, 28, 32, 34, 35 runs brighter away from the lamp, not toward it.

changes.expected: The far table drops to a lum_median of about 12-18 while the area in front of the lamp keeps most of its value, so the lamp becomes the table's main source.

changes.problem: The lamp throws almost no light onto the table in front of it: the pool there is only about 2 levels warmer than the far table.

evidence.measured: r_median 60 vs 48 on the far table; lum_p95 42.5. There is no visible pool shape.

changes.expected: A red-amber pool on the table in front of the foot, with r_median about 90-130, fading over roughly 200 px toward the frame edges.

changes.problem: The red channel of the glowing core clips, so the bore column reads as a flat salmon bar with no gradient or tint.

evidence.measured: clip_pct 75.97, r_median 254, g 145, b 131, lum_range 33.6. The core is flat.

change.setting: view transform / highlight rolloff (not on card)
change.to: AgX (or Filmic) Medium High Contrast with highlight rolloff, re-matched exposure

changes.expected: The core holds a visible vertical gradient, red does not clip, and the colour shifts from hot orange in the middle to deep red at the edges.

changes.problem: The black anodised foot and the knob are lost: the foot is pure black against a dark table, with no edge.

evidence.measured: lum_median 1.0, lum_p95 2.6, crush_pct 96.1. Adjacent table [380,560,460,650] is 23.6. Edge step across the foot's left side is only -4.9 over 18 px.

change.to: a strip area light, 10 x 60 cm, about 1.2 m behind the lamp and 40 cm left of it, at foot height (8 cm above the table), aimed at the foot. Neutral 4000 K, strong enough to put a 2-4 px rim highlight of about lum 60-90 on the foot's left and right edges and a catchlight on the knob.

changes.expected: The foot reads as a dark anodised cylinder with lit edges, its body stays at lum 5-15, and the knob shows one bright knurled highlight.

changes.problem: The tinted discs all read as one dark red. The buffed and bead-blasted strata do not separate because nothing reflects off their faces or edges.

evidence.measured: lum_median 11.1, lum_range 22.3, R46 G2 B0. Right side [660,300,745,520]: lum_median 11.2.

change.to: a tall thin softbox, 15 x 120 cm, camera-right at about 60 degrees to the lens axis, 1 m from the lamp, low power (about 1/10 of the fill), so the buffed discs pick up a thin vertical sheen line that the satin discs diffuse

changes.expected: A vertical specular line on the lamp's right side that breaks at the satin discs, so the strata alternate bright and dull. The side bands' lum_range rises above 50.

changes.problem: An unexplained light sliver at the left frame edge, plus books cut by the frame, pull the eye out of the picture.

evidence.measured: A vertical object strip with lum_range 53.5 (p5 6.6, p95 60.1) at the extreme edge. The books span x 0-290, cut by the frame.

change.from: books stack at frame-left plus the edge object
change.to: remove the edge object; keep one two-book stack, moved so its whole footprint sits within x 120-330, behind the lamp's plane

changes.expected: Nothing touches the left frame edge, and the table there is a smooth dark wood value.

changes.problem: The plate and pear are cut by the right frame edge, which reads as an accident and competes with the lamp.

evidence.measured: The plate rim runs off the frame. lum_median 44.4 is brighter than the table and the wall (31-34), so it is a secondary bright spot at the edge.

change.from: plate with pear at frame-right edge

changes.expected: The right side becomes table and wall only, with lum_median under 25 after c1.

changes.problem: The wall behind is a flat, evenly lit plane, so the lamp has no glow halo and no depth separation.

evidence.measured: Wall x-profile 27.7, 28.6, 29.9, 34.6, 36.6, 33.9, 33.9, 29.1: a range of only 9 levels across the frame.

changes.expected: With c1 and c2, the wall falls off from the lamp's halo (about lum 35-45 directly behind the cap) to about 12-18 at the corners, and the background props soften.

out_of_scope.request: Make the seven amber discs read amber rather than deep red.
out_of_scope.why: The card specifies seven amber discs and one deep red, but every disc renders as R~45 G~2 B0, so the colour stratification of the design is invisible. The tints are fixed to the published transmission, so this needs the owner to confirm whether the transmission or the path length through the disc stack is right.

out_of_scope.request: Soften the bright vertical bore column showing through the discs.
out_of_scope.why: It dominates the lamp and reads as a separate bar rather than light inside acrylic, but it is the lamp's design (the opal tube in the bore).
